answers.core: Because this feature is to detect a potentially un-intuitive and hard to diagnose behavior, people are unlikely to install an addon specifically to address such a niche problem, or have the foresight to do it before they need it.
answers.workaround:
Nearly every project I do involves AnimationTree with BlendTree and some amount of filtering, so I think it would be used fairly often. It could be implemented in a manner which is completely unobtrusive, so people who don't need it would not notice it.

I don't believe a script could fix it, or would be the appropriate way to address it.

title: Add warnings for BlendTree filtering new tracks/keyframes
